newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico City water rates to rise 23 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mexico City water rates to rise 23 pct in 1997.

text.p: Mexico City water rates will rise 23 percent in 1997, Javier Beristain, the city's Finance Minister told national radio Tuesday.
Beristain said, for metered properties, there will also be a new fixed minimum charge of 30 pesos for each two-month payment period for consumption up to 30 cubic metres.
"We are still fine tuning the proposals ... it could be that use up to 10 cubic metres is exempt," he said.
Mexico is slowly moving to metering water use and most of Mexico City is expected to come on line in 1997, although some properties still have fixed charges, irrespective of use.
Inflation over the 12-month-period through last October was about 29 percent.
